normal.name: Boris Kretzinger
normal.text: I am thinking about an Atari Jaguar meeting in 2027, possibly June, somewhere outside of Frankfurt am Main, Germany (but not too far away). As the next eJagFest is two years away, maybe some enthusiasts would like to meet in the year between the JagFests? 😎 Just a thought. I have two locations in mind, but have not yet asked them. Who would be interested? Bring your Jaguar, play some games, present your project ... what do you think? #atari #atarijaguar #retrogaming #retromeet

normal.name: Raindrac
normal.text: …and the wheels aren’t actually doing anything, they’re just decorative. It also makes the back of the kart to stick out in the opposite direction of the turn, meaning the back of your kart can hit an obstacle to your right if you turn left… And that’s a problem! Turning to the left shouldn’t cause you to hit an object on your right! I’m sure I can get used to it, so I’m going to keep playing. Still, at least I know why the game feels so weird now. #mariokart #gaming #retrogaming

normal.text: Dad was cleaning out his house and brought a few boxes of stuff out. Mostly childhood mementos but among the clutter was a boxed copy of Civilization 2: Test of Time. I miss the old giant game boxes too. #gaming #retrogaming
